description: Na₃MgCPO₇ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁ space group. There are three inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to six O atoms to form NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent PO₄ tetrahedra, edges with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, and edges with two equivalent MgO₅ trigonal bipyramids. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.30-2.46 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.23-2.78 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with four equivalent PO₄ tetrahedra, corners with four equivalent MgO₅ trigonal bipyramids, and faces with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.26-2.65 Å. Mg is bonded to five O atoms to form distorted MgO₅ trigonal bipyramids that share corners with four equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, corners with three equivalent PO₄ tetrahedra, and edges with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 71-83°. There are a spread of Mg-O bond distances ranging from 2.01-2.19 Å. C is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. There are a spread of C-O bond distances ranging from 1.29-1.32 Å. P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with six NaO₆ octahedra and corners with three equivalent MgO₅ trigonal bipyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 52-69°. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.54-1.57 Å. There are seven inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to three Na and one C atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three Na, one Mg, and one C atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Mg, and one P atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Mg, and one P atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, one Mg, and one C atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded to three Na and one P atom to form distorted corner-sharing ONa₃P tetrahedra. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, one Mg, and one P atom.
